ValidationRule.description: Created per Colin and Ryan O. to ensure we do not sell to clients without meeting this threshold. Changing rule from 10% to 90% so Sales can add quotes. Cant create a quote with this rule in place.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato", RecordType.Name = 'Travel', Probability >0.90, Opp_ARR__c < 5000.00, NOT(HasOpportunityLineItem) ) && Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must add a Product and Opportunity Amount must be over $5000. If you are trying to add a quote, please move Stage back to discovery, add quote then move forward.
